Sample rates per acre

Every number below is a sample range from our published sheet. Your ground may move it.

Sample pricing — rates vary by ground class
ItemRange Sample pricingUnitNote
Forestry mulching, palmetto and brush $1,200–$2,400 per acre open sand, brush under 4 inches
Forestry mulching, oak hammock $2,400–$4,800 per acre dense oak and vines, trees up to 8 inches
Pasture reclamation $800–$1,600 per acre dog fennel, saplings and fence-row brush
Stump grinding $150–$450 per stump by diameter at ground level
Storm debris cleanup $650–$2,500 most residential lots, one to two days
Invasive plant treatment visit $350–$900 per follow-up visit, by patch size

All ranges above are Sample pricing. Your ground may move the number.

Mulched in place, nothing burned

The brush goes back into the soil as mulch. No haul-off fee, no burn pile, no bare dirt moonscape. The ground stays covered and the roots stay put unless you ask for grading.

We walk the lot with you first. Keeper trees get flagged. The machine size matches your gate and your ground.
